name: Hey_2
short_caption: The robot enthusiastically raises both arms above its head and waves to greet or get the attention of a visitor.
movement_description: The robot starts from a neutral posture and raises both arms symmetrically outwards and upwards high above its head with hands open. It then waves its hands left and right in a rapid, cheerful waving motion to greet the visitor. Finally, it lowers both arms back down to its sides, returning smoothly to the neutral resting position.
safety_notes: Requires clearance above the robot and to the sides due to high vertical and lateral arm extension.
